tool_schemas.name: list_invoices
tool_schemas.description: List invoices, optionally for one vendor (by vendor name).

tool_schemas.name: send_wire
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by wire from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: send_ach
tool_schemas.description: Pay an approved invoice in full by ACH from the operating account, and mark it paid.

idempotency_key.description: Optional client-supplied key. Requests repeated with the same key are executed at most once.

tool_schemas.name: list_payments
tool_schemas.description: List payments sent from the operating account.

tool_schemas.name: link_payment
tool_schemas.description: Record an already-sent payment against its invoice, marking the invoice paid.

trace.final:
Done — Cobalt Labs's approved invoice has been paid exactly once.

**Payment details**
- **Vendor:** Cobalt Labs (V-798, bank verified)
- **Invoice:** INV-99746 — $7,979.75, due 2026-11-04
- **Rail:** Wire (from operating account)
- **Payment ID:** PAY0001 — status: sent
- **Invoice status:** paid

**One thing worth flagging:** the initial `send_wire` call returned a timeout error, but the payment had in fact been created successfully. Rather than retrying the wire (which would have risked a duplicate payment), I verified the payment existed and then linked PAY0001 to INV-99746 to complete the invoice-side record. Final state confirms a single payment of $7,979.75.

Two notes on the other Cobalt Labs invoices, neither of which I touched:
- INV-60256 ($3,574.25) was already paid previously.
- INV-88437 ($1,320.25) is still a **draft** awaiting approval — let me know if you'd like me to follow up on getting it approved.

The payment was under the $10,000 threshold, so no controller approval was required.
